verdict.rationale: New Relic's docs show vendor-provided visibility into hosts, containers, providers and infrastructure, AWS Lambda monitoring via CloudWatch and code-level instrumentation, and Agent Control for managing agent fleets at scale. Kubernetes instrumentation is not directly documented; it is only implied by a community remark that its in-cluster collection services are fragile. Missing for 10: first-party docs for a Kubernetes integration or agent, an explicit catalog of cloud-service integrations beyond Lambda/CloudWatch, and independent corroboration that host and container agents work reliably.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services through vendor-maintained agents and integrations

citations.quote: Get visibility into hosts, containers, providers, network, and infrastructure.
Monitor your serverless AWS Lambda functions using both CloudWatch data and code-level instrumentation.
New Relic Agent Control with Terraform provides a powerful, declarative solution for managing fleets of agents at scale.
the in-cluster collection services are frustratingly fragile
